memory_candidates: CSLib Temporal task 180: when an F1-class defeq break occurs on a formula NESTED under a temporal modality (inside G(...)/H(...) or under someFuture/somePast) or nested inside another implication's codomain -- not a top-level MCS-membership site -- the mcs_allFuture_iff/mcs_allPast_iff MCS-level bridge lemmas are NOT sufficient by themselves. The fix requires a DerivationTree-level bridge: take the relevant bridge axiom (allFuture_to_classic/classic_to_allFuture/allPast_to_classic/classic_to_allPast), optionally its contrapositive via a `contraposition` helper, then lift it through the temporal modality via necessitation (temporal_necessitation/pastNecessitation) + the monotonicity axiom (right_mono_until/right_mono_since) + modus_ponens -- mirroring the existing DNE-lifting idiom already present in these files (e.g. RRelation.lean's h_g_dne/h_bx3 block).

CSLib Temporal task 180: `contraposition` (A->B gives ¬B->¬A on DerivationTree) lives in Cslib.Logic.Temporal.Metalogic namespace (GeneralizedNecessitation.lean).
